questions.stem_text:
The rules governing the electoral college make it especially important for presidential
candidates to

options.A: win as many states as possible, regardless of the size of the states
options.B: spend most of their time campaigning in the South
options.C: campaign most aggressively among those who will be chosen as electors
options.D: concentrate their campaign efforts on "battleground" states

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - concentrate their campaign efforts on "battleground" states

questions.stem_text: Why has network news coverage become less diverse in recent years?

options.A: Decreasing liberal bias in the news media
options.B: Increasing visibility for individual candidates on TV
options.C: Increasing concentration of ownership in the news media
options.D: Decreasing cost of political ads on TV

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Increasing concentration of ownership in the news media

questions.stem_text:
International trade will almost always benefit both countries, so why do countries try to
protect their own firms from exposure to the world market?

options.A: Irrationality on the part of the leadership
options.B: Costs of free trade are concentrated, but benefits are dispersed

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Costs of free trade are concentrated, but benefits are dispersed

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT true of executive orders?

options.A: Presidents avoid using executive orders for controversial actions.
options.B: Executive orders have the same effect as laws passed by Congress.
options.C: Presidents have made increased use of executive orders since the 1970 s.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Presidents avoid using executive orders for controversial actions.
